candidates.definition: The number of effectors (one hand versus two coordinated hands) is recorded by no rule, facet or listed manipulation; the listed hand manipulation is about which hand, not how many.

candidates.definition: The size of the item set (thousands of items) and the number of sessions, with item-level regression replacing a factorial design; no rule, facet or listed manipulation records the scale of the item set.

candidates.definition: The imagined reference frame (self rotates vs object rotates) is set by instruction, and the egocentric form asks for the appearance from a new viewpoint rather than a same-or-mirror judgment; no rule, facet or listed manipulation records the frame of the imagined transformation.

candidates.definition: The number of effectors (two hands tracing together versus one) is recorded by no rule, facet or listed manipulation.

candidates.promote_when: The same difference is found in a second task.

candidates.definition: The response demanded becomes effortful (sustained force or many presses) rather than a single speeded press; no respond_to_rule rule records response effort, and there is no choice, so the amount_vs_effort tradeoff of choose_for_outcomes does not apply.

candidates.definition: The number of effectors (two coordinated hands versus one) is recorded by no rule, facet or listed manipulation.

candidates.definition: Targets become intermittently invisible during the tracking interval; no rule, facet, or listed manipulation (targets, distractors, speed, duration) records the visibility of the tracked items.

candidates.definition: The dimension on which the deviant differs (duration vs pitch) is stimulus content inside the same stimulus_type; the task's manipulation list has no deviant-dimension item, so nothing records it.

candidates.promote_when: The same difference is found in a second task.

candidates.definition: The axis of the stimulus and response layout (vertical instead of horizontal); not a listed manipulation, and no rule or facet records the spatial arrangement of responses.

candidates.definition: The familiarity of the person shown as the reward changes; no delivery facet, rule, or listed manipulation records whether a social stimulus is a known person or a stranger.

candidates.definition: The number of withhold items in the mapping is recorded by no rule, facet or listed manipulation (the same gap as Multi-Stimulus Go/No-Go).
